verdict.rationale: Numeral documents a real-time calculation API: a POST to `/tax/calculations` takes an address and products and returns the tax to charge, and its integrations calculate tax at checkout time. Nothing in the pack shows address-level (rooftop) jurisdiction resolution as opposed to ZIP-level lookup, and the newer IP-based resolution points to coarser location input, not finer. There are also no latency figures or SLAs, so suitability inside checkout is only implied. Missing for 10: documented rooftop/address-level geolocation accuracy, latency/performance guarantees for in-checkout use, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can calculate the right sales tax for a transaction through an API in real time — address-level (rooftop) accuracy, not ZIP-code approximations — fast enough to sit inside checkout

citations.quote: You'll give us an address and a set of products, and we'll return the accurate tax amount you should charge.
Query a tax calculation with a POST to `/tax/calculations`
Each integration handles tax calculation at checkout or invoice time
